verdict.rationale: dlt publishes agent-oriented docs. Probes confirm a live llms.txt at dlthub.com/llms.txt and Markdown versions of doc pages (e.g. /docs/intro.md); a docs-level llms.txt is described as 'Built for LLMs'; and a .well-known agent-skills index plus the AI Harness of skills and rules teach coding agents to build pipelines. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on evidence that agents actually work well when pointed at these llms.txt and Markdown docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Built for LLMs with 8000+ source connectors.
The dltHub AI Harness is a set of skills, rules, and MCP servers that teach a general-purpose coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex) how to build production-grade pipelines
we turn AI assistants into expert dlt pipeline developers across over 11,200 REST API data sources.
